caption: A three-tiered white figure resembling a stacked-cotton snowman stands centered against a textured yellow backdrop. The top sphere wears a small green cylindrical cap, the middle sphere projects two short side protrusions like arms, and each tier carries a vertical line of blue dotted marks. The figure rests on a clear glass tumbler on a white plate over a gray surface, with the camera fixed throughout. Across the clip the head sphere and its green cap drift steadily downward, so the cap sinks deeper into the head and the head closes the gap toward the middle sphere. The middle sphere and its arms stay level with the bottom sphere, keeping the lower junction open while only the neck compresses. The bottom sphere, glass, plate, and yellow background remain fixed, confirming the motion is internal to the figure rather than a camera pan. The change is slow and smooth, with the blue markings translating only with their host spheres and no sudden jump visible.
relations: Head sphere and green cap drift downward, sinking the cap into the head and closing the neck gap toward the middle sphere.
